clauses.title: Scope – Covers manufacture
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Covers manufacture and requirements of metal faced plywood composite. The scope is limited to the use of galvanized iron sheet or aluminium sheet only, as metal sheet.

clauses.title: Plywood
clauses.text: 2.1 Plywood  — Shall be BWR grade conforming to IS 303 : 1989*.

clauses.title: Galvanised Iron Sheets
clauses.text: 2.2 Galvanised Iron Sheets— Shall conform to IS 277 : 1992++.

clauses.title: Aluminium Sheet
clauses.text: 2.3 Aluminium Sheet — Shall conform to IS   737 : 1986 @.

clauses.title: Phenol formaldehyde (PF) resin
clauses.text: 2.4.1 Phenol formaldehyde (PF) resin — Phenol formaldehyde resol resin shall be used for bonding galvanized sheet or aluminium sheet with plywood.

clauses.title: Polyvinyl acetal resin ?
clauses.text: 2.4.2 Polyvinyl acetal resin ? Polyvinyl formal or polyvinyl butyral resin shall be used in combination with phenol formaldehyde resol  resin.

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions and Tolerances—The dimensions of metal faced plywood boards shall be as given for plywood in  IS  12049 :1987§. Thickness of metal faced plywood boards shall be as given in Table 1. clauses.title: Tolerances – The tolerances
clauses.text: 3.1 Tolerances - The tolerances on the nominal sizes of finished boards shall be as specified in IS 12049:1987.

clauses.title: Workmanship and Finish
clauses.text: 4. Workmanship and Finish—The metal faced plywood boards shall be of uniform thickness within the tolerance limits specified.

clauses.title: Bond Quality Test –
clauses.text: 5.1 Bond Quality Test - A specimen shall be considered to have passed the test if : a) No visible delamination has occured in the glue lines of plywood and if no visible delamination has occured between the plywood faces and the metal sheet, and b) On forcible seperation using a suitable lever, wood fibres are found adhered to the metal sheet uniformly over the entire surface.

clauses.title: Optional Tests
clauses.text: 5.2 Optional Tests : a) Modulus of elasticity b) Modulus of rupture c) Core shear stress d) Facing stress Note—For method of tests refer to the standard.
